title.narrative: Strengthening the Power of Youth Voices Annual Report October 2024 - Sept 2025

description.narrative: The program implemented a wide array of offline and online interventions to enhance youth engagement in civic and governance processes in Kericho, Nairobi, Lamu, Kitui, Busia and Homabay, including community agenda setting forums, local exchange and learning, civic and governance art expo, community sports dialogue forums, regional students leaders forum; Additional activities included ongoing social media engagements, social media campaigns, social media leadership accountability board, collectively, these interventions reached 323,860 participants. Out of which 317,849 online (290,355 reached and 27,494 engaged) and 6,011 offline (3,663 men - 61%, 2,348 women - 39%, and 171persons with disabilities - 3%) and involved 80 government officials from both national and county levels, including area chiefs, ward and village administrators, members of county assemblies, youth officers, gender officers and registrar of persons. The program supported youth-led advocacy initiatives and strengthened the capacity of 15 local community based organizations and the youth leaders which led to the identification of 90 governance issues and addressing 43 (48%) governance issues, such as the construction of Kanziko Stadium Pavillion in Kitui County; installation of security lights at Kanziko Stadium, Kitui County; reinstallation of electricity transformer at Ekani Village in Kanziko, Kitui County; reopening of Kericho Forest Dispensary and Tarmacing of Mail 4 road in Chepseon ward, Kericho County; construction of new toilets at Budalangi Health Centre in Busia County; murraming of Rapenda Bumacheke Road in Budalangi, Busia County; reconnection of water at Makongeni Sub County Hospital in Homabay County; restoration of electricity in Kanziko and Mwangala Market in Kitui County; repair of community water point in Bukhori village in Bunyala North, Busia County; murraming of Munana to Sigalame to Sioport Road in Samia sub-county, Busia County; construction of a new mortuary at Mbita Sub county hospital in Homabay County; installation of a new transformer at Kisui and Kirambo village in Homabay County; completion of Thuon Gweno Health centre with new toilets in Homabay County; completion of Mlachake to Lake Kenyatta Primary school road in Bahari ward, Lamu County; completion of Kaguria water project in South Kabuoch Ward in Ndhiwa, Homabay County; completion of construction of ECDE classroom at Waregi Primary School in Mbita, Homabay County; extension of operation of Ober Dispensary in Ndhiwa, Homabay County; repair of a sewerline in Central ward in Homabay town; supply of drugs at Sio-port sub county hospital in Funyula, Busia County; construction of a new ECDE classroom in Kedowa ward, Kericho county; murraming of chepcholoet mosomborik road in Kericho County; connection of electricity in Kapsenda Dispensary in Londiani, Kericho County; operationalization of Hongwe Market in Lamu County; construction of a pavilion in Mpeketoni, Lamu County; completion of Jericho Primary School classroom in Lamu County; murruming and grading of Kanziko - Mutha road in Kitui County. Completed projects impacted the community's lives positively by improving service delivery and increasing accountability at the local level.While the project has established better trends, youth transition and inadequate platforms for people with disability had been a challenge in the implementation of the program.In year four, the program will focus on expanding devolution of mentorship, further creation of more youth engagement platforms and supporting a series of engagements especially on the alternative platforms. The program will also expand on intergenerational dialogue forums
